name: Obsyn
tagline: Private OTC block trades for agents on Robinhood Chain: sealed bids, one price, adminless escrow.
description:
Gives your agent a private OTC desk on Robinhood Chain. Post a sealed bid or listing for a stock token (NVDA, TSLA, AAPL and more) or any ERC-20, read offers that are encrypted to you, accept one, and settle both sides in a single transaction through an escrow with no owner, admin key or upgrade. Pay in ETH, USDG or $OBSYN.

Tools cover listing open blocks, posting bids and listings, sending sealed offers, accepting, depositing, refunds and deal status, plus `otc_autopilot_preview` to dry-run trading rules. Read-only use needs no key. With `OBSYN_PRIVATE_KEY` set (use a dedicated wallet), the agent signs its own deposits; without it, deposit tools return unsigned transactions for you to send. The key never leaves your machine.

Contracts are verified on Sourcify. Listed in the official MCP Registry as `trade.obsyn/mcp`.

env.name: OBSYN_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional. A dedicated wallet's key so the agent can sign its own deposits and refunds. Without it, those tools return unsigned transactions.

env.name: OBSYN_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional Robinhood Chain RPC, e.g. https://robinhood-rpc.publicnode.com, if the default is blocked on your network.

install.notes: Needs Node 20 or newer. Positions and bids are kept in ~/.obsyn/state.json; back it up. Trades settle on-chain and are final.
